use_case: SP Metro CE / Mobile Backhaul / Aggregation
notes: Compact metro/aggregation router. Used for SP cell site backhaul, business services, and metro CE. Carrier Ethernet features built-in.

use_case: SP Metro CE / Cell Site Backhaul (small / ruggedized)
notes: Compact SP CE router. 901S is the small/ruggedized variant for outdoor enclosures. Being superseded by ASR 920 and NCS 540. Limited new development.
Fixed-chassis ultra-high-density variant of ASR 9000 family. Uses Lightspeed/Lightspeed-Plus silicon. High port-density peering/core router.

use_case: SP ROADM / Optical Line System (OLS) / DWDM
notes: Multi-degree ROADM platform. Core optical transport for SP long-haul and metro DWDM networks. Works with NCS 1000 transponders.
Converged packet-optical platform combining IP/MPLS and OTN. Limited updates; NCS 5500 and NCS 2000 are successor platforms for routing and optical respectively.

use_case: Virtual SP Router (lab / simulation / cloud PE)
notes: Software-only virtual IOS-XR platform. Used for network emulation, testing, and as a cloud PE in NFV/cloud deployments.
Large modular variants of the Cisco 8000 family. Based on Silicon One ASIC. Designed for hyperscale peering and SP transit/core.
Fixed-chassis NCS 5500 variants with modular uplink slots. Cost-effective metro aggregation and peering.
Large SP core router. Succeeded by Cisco 8000 and ASR 9000 next-gen. Limited updates; plan migration.

example_pids: ASR-9000 with BNG license; vBNG VM
notes: Broadband Network Gateway function for SP subscriber management (PPPoE, IPoE, RADIUS). Runs on ASR 9000 hardware or as a virtual network function (vBNG).
